_comment: #62 — the §F2 missing-paired-baselines refusal, CAPTURED FROM THE SWIFT SOURCE rather
than restated in a Rust literal. benchd must emit these bytes exactly; Swift is the
reference, so anything else is a parity bug.
In Swift the message is three concatenated string literals, which is precisely why a
prefix-only assertion could not see tail drift:
"\(context) requires external Qwen benchmark baselines for "
+ "both prefill and decode; Gemma baseline constants are "
`context` is the caller's mode name (Swift `options.modeName`), interpolated at the
FRONT — so one message per mode below, each asserted in full.

messages.local-iterate: local-iterate requires external Qwen benchmark baselines for both prefill and decode; Gemma baseline constants are not valid for Qwen
messages.local-submit: local-submit requires external Qwen benchmark baselines for both prefill and decode; Gemma baseline constants are not valid for Qwen
messages.official: official requires external Qwen benchmark baselines for both prefill and decode; Gemma baseline constants are not valid for Qwen
